```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(qs)
library(scCustomize)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
source("/users/PAS2148/tiger/Tigerrr07/scripts/R_scripts/Heatmap.R")
WL_seu <- qread("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/WL_fibroblasts_aucell.qs")

setwd("/users/PAS2148/tiger/scRNA_analysis_code/fibroblasts")

save.path <- "Fig_2_figures"
if (!dir.exists(save.path)) {
  dir.create(save.path, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
plot_data <- FetchData(WL_seu, 
                       vars = c("Collagens", "MMPs", "TIMPs", "Condition", "annotation"))
plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Collagens", "MMPs", "TIMPs"), 
               names_to = "Gene", 
               values_to = "Expression")
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("IPF upper lobe", "Aged control"),
  c("IPF lower lobe", "Aged control")
)
```

## Fig. 2a

```{r, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}

# Plot 1: Collagens only
collagens_data <- subset(plot_data_long, Gene == "Collagens")

p_collagens <- ggplot(collagens_data, aes(x = Condition, y = Expression, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.9, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ annotation, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    label.y = c(0.5, 0.54),
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Aged control" = "#717e8d",
    "IPF upper lobe" = "#8ca252",
    "IPF lower lobe" = "#ae8ba2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "black", size=14),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", lineend = "square"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", lineend = "square"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.58))

ggsave(file.path(save.path, "WL_Collagens_boxplot.pdf"), p_collagens, width = 13, height = 8)
print(p_collagens)

```

## Fig. 2b

```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8, warning=FALSE}
anno_colors <- list(
  annotation = c(
    "Alveolar" = "#3CA5D1",
    "Adventitial" = "#8D8DC3",
    "Inflammatory" = "#EF9F80",
    "SMC" = "#D28088",
    "CTHRC1+" = "#FF5919",
    "Peribronchial" = "#58A456"

  ),
  Condition = c(
    "Aged control" = "#717e8d",
    "IPF upper lobe" = "#8ca252",
    "IPF lower lobe" = "#ae8ba2"
  )
)

collagen_gene_dict <- list(
  "Anchoring" = c("COL13A1"),
  "Basement membrane-associated" = c("COL21A1", "COL22A1"),
  "Fibril-associated (FACITs)" = c("COL14A1", "COL15A1", "COL16A1"),
  "Fibrillar" = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL2A1", "COL3A1", "COL5A1", "COL5A2", "COL6A1", "COL7A1"),
  "Network-forming" = c("COL8A1", "COL10A1", "COL11A1", "COL12A1"),
  "Other fibril-associated" = c("COL23A1", "COL24A1", "COL25A1", "COL26A1", "COL27A1", "COL28A1"),
  "Transmembrance" = c("COL17A1", "COL18A1", "COL19A1"),
  "CTHRC1" = c("CTHRC1")
)

collagen_colors =c(
  "Anchoring" = "#b383b9",
  "Basement membrane-associated" = "#f4c17b",
  "Fibril-associated (FACITs)" = "#d2eac8",
  "Fibrillar" = "#f5cfe4",
  "Network-forming" = "#d9d9d9",
  "Other fibril-associated" = "#bbde93",
  "Transmembrance" = "#fcee82",
  "CTHRC1" = "#FF5919"
)

colors <- c("#4A90E2", "#D9D9D9", "#D0021B")
scHeatmap(WL_seu, features = collagen_gene_dict, 
          group.by = c("annotation", "Condition"),
          anno_colors = anno_colors, width = 9, height = 8, colors = colors,
          custom_set_colors = collagen_colors,
                    save_path = file.path(save.path, "WL_Collagen_gene_heatmap.pdf")
          )
```

## Fig. 2e

```{r, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}
timps_data <- subset(plot_data_long, Gene == "TIMPs")

p_timps <- ggplot(timps_data, aes(x = Condition, y = Expression, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.9, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ annotation, nrow = 1) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    label.y = c(0.9, 0.95),
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Aged control" = "#717e8d",
    "IPF upper lobe" = "#8ca252",
    "IPF lower lobe" = "#ae8ba2"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "black", size=14),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size=14),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size=14),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(save.path, "WL_TIMPs_boxplot.pdf"), p_mmps, width = 13, height = 8)
print(p_timps)
```
